title: Atomic and Bluevine Join Forces
summary: Turnkey digital experiences. Fully customizable front-end experiences that can be tailored to your design system. Developer-friendly APIs.
body_markdown:
> *Watch the interview directly on Bloomberg*[here](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2025-02-28/atomic-and-bluevine-join-forces-video) .


CEO David Dindi was live on Bloomberg TV to discuss the recent partnership between Bluevine and Atomic. Through this partnership, Bluevine is empowering hundreds of thousands of small and medium-sized businesses to access treasury management capabilities that were previously reserved for larger enterprises. David also discussed how Atomic helps retail investors access private credit opportunities, and gave some thoughts more broadly on the state of the current digital asset ecosystem.
